New Model w/ Transparencies removed
```{r}
ps_model2 <- glm(Treated ~ G_Trend + GOY_Plant + GOY_People + GOY_Animals,
                data = data, family = binomial)

summary(ps_model2)

# add propensity scores to dataset
data$propensity_score <- predict(ps_model2, newdata = data, type = "response")

# Quick look
data[, c("Brand", "Treated", "propensity_score")]

```


Matching them
```{r}
library(MatchIt)

m.out <- matchit(Treated ~ Revenue + Stock + G_Trend +
                   GOY_Plant + GOY_People + GOY_Animals,
                 data = data,
                 method = "nearest", distance = data$propensity_score)

summary(m.out)

matched_data <- match.data(m.out)
head(matched_data)

matched_data[, c("Brand", "Treated", "propensity_score", "subclass")]

```

Matched Pairs Revenue 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Keep the matching assignments
matching_info <- matched_data %>%
  select(Brand, Treated, subclass)

# Merge onto full dataset
final_matched_rev <- fulldata %>%
  left_join(matching_info, by = c("Brand", "Treated"))

rev_diffs_all <- final_matched_rev %>%
  group_by(subclass, Relative_Year) %>%
  summarize(
    diff = Revenue[Treated == 1] - Revenue[Treated == 0],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean(rev_diffs_all$diff, na.rm = TRUE)

t.test(rev_diffs_all$diff)
```

DiD set up
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read and prepare data
#--------------------------------------------------
fulldata <- read_excel("C:/Users/stewa/OneDrive/Documents/Final_Data.xlsx")

df <- fulldata %>%
  mutate(
    # Make sure Treated is 0/1
    Treated      = as.integer(Treated == 1),

    # Clean DiD "Post" indicator: 1 from Relative_Year >= 0 onward, 0 before
    Post         = as.integer(Relative_Year >= 0),

    # Factors and IDs
    Brand        = factor(Brand),
    Year         = as.integer(Year),
    Matched_Pair = factor(Matched_Pair),

    # Outcomes (ensure values are > 0 in your data)
    log_rev      = log(Revenue),
    log_stock    = log(Stock)  # use if Stock > 0; otherwise adjust
  )

#--------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create a clean dataset for DiD (only vars we need)
#   This avoids dropping rows because of NAs in other columns
#--------------------------------------------------
df_did <- df %>%
  select(
    Brand, Year, Relative_Year,
    Treated, Post, Matched_Pair,
    log_rev, log_stock
  ) %>%
  # drop rows where the actual outcome or key indicators are NA
  filter(!is.na(log_rev),
         !is.na(log_stock),
         !is.na(Treated),
         !is.na(Post),
         !is.na(Relative_Year))

# Quick sanity checks
summary(df_did$Post)
table(df_did$Treated, df_did$Post, useNA = "ifany")
nrow(df_did)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 3. Main DiD: Revenue (log scale)
#   log(Revenue) ~ Treated * Post + Brand FE + Year FE
#--------------------------------------------------
did_rev <- feols(
  log_rev ~ Treated * Post | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did
)

summary(did_rev)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 4. Main DiD: Stock (log scale)
#   log(Stock) ~ Treated * Post + Brand FE + Year FE
#--------------------------------------------------
did_stock <- feols(
  log_stock ~ Treated * Post | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did
)

summary(did_stock)
```

DiD Revenue and Stock
```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------
# 5. OPTIONAL: Add matched-pair fixed effects
#--------------------------------------------------
did_rev_pair <- feols(
  log_rev ~ Treated * Post | Brand + Year + Matched_Pair,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did
)

summary(did_rev_pair)

did_stock_pair <- feols(
  log_stock ~ Treated * Post | Brand + Year + Matched_Pair,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did
)

summary(did_stock_pair)
library(fixest)
library(broom)
library(data.table)  # for %like%

#--------------------------------------------------
# 6. Event-study (dynamic DiD) for Revenue
#--------------------------------------------------
did_event_rev <- feols(
  log_rev ~ i(Relative_Year, Treated, ref = -1) | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data = df_did
)

# ??? FULL coefficient table WITH p-values
rev_table <- summary(did_event_rev)$coeftable
print(rev_table)

# ??? Filter only Relative Year × Treated rows
rev_es <- data.table(rev_table, keep.rownames = "term")[term %like% "Relative_Year"]
print(rev_es)



#--------------------------------------------------
# Event-study plot
#--------------------------------------------------
iplot(
  did_event_rev,
  main = "Event-Study: Effect of Treatment on log(Revenue)",
  xlab = "Relative Year (0 = commitment year)",
  ylab = "Coefficient (vs. Relative Year -1)"
)



#--------------------------------------------------
# 7. Event-study for Stock
#--------------------------------------------------
did_event_stock <- feols(
  log_stock ~ i(Relative_Year, Treated, ref = -1) | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data = df_did
)

# ??? FULL coefficient table WITH p-values
stock_table <- summary(did_event_stock)$coeftable
print(stock_table)

# ??? Filter only Relative Year × Treated rows
stock_es <- data.table(stock_table, keep.rownames = "term")[term %like% "Relative_Year"]
print(stock_es)



#--------------------------------------------------
# Event-study plot
#--------------------------------------------------
iplot(
  did_event_stock,
  main = "Event-Study: Effect of Treatment on log(Stock)",
  xlab = "Relative Year (0 = commitment year)",
  ylab = "Coefficient (vs. Relative Year -1)"
)


```



DiD Model
```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read and prepare data
#--------------------------------------------------
fulldata <- read_excel("C:/Users/stewa/OneDrive/Documents/Final_Data.xlsx")

df <- fulldata %>%
  mutate(
    # Treatment + timing
    Treated      = as.integer(Treated == 1),
    Post         = as.integer(Relative_Year >= 0),

    # IDs / factors
    Brand        = factor(Brand),
    Year         = as.integer(Year),
    Matched_Pair = factor(Matched_Pair),

    # Outcomes used previously
    log_rev      = log(Revenue),
    log_stock    = log(Stock),

    # ---- NEW: G Trends outcome ----
    # If you want raw G Trends:
    gtrend       = G_Trend
    # If you decide to log it instead, use:
    # log_gtrend = log(G_Trend)
  )

#--------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean dataset for DiD on G Trends
#--------------------------------------------------
df_did_g <- df %>%
  select(
    Brand, Year, Relative_Year,
    Treated, Post,
    gtrend
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gtrend),
    !is.na(Treated),
    !is.na(Post),
    !is.na(Relative_Year)
  )

# Quick sanity checks
summary(df_did_g$gtrend)
table(df_did_g$Treated, df_did_g$Post, useNA = "ifany")
nrow(df_did_g)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 3. Main DiD: G Trends
#   G_Trend ~ Treated * Post + Brand FE + Year FE
#--------------------------------------------------
did_gtrend <- feols(
  gtrend ~ Treated * Post | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did_g
)

summary(did_gtrend)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 4. Event-study for G Trends
#   Dynamic effects across Relative_Year
#--------------------------------------------------
did_event_gtrend <- feols(
  gtrend ~ i(Relative_Year, Treated, ref = -1) | Brand + Year,
  cluster = ~ Brand,
  data    = df_did_g
)

summary(did_event_gtrend)

iplot(
  did_event_gtrend,
  main = "Event-Study: Effect of Treatment on Google Trends",
  xlab = "Relative Year (0 = commitment year)",
  ylab = "Coefficient (vs. Relative Year -1)"
)

```

Transparency Graph
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

fulldata$Brand <- factor(fulldata$Brand, levels = sort(unique(fulldata$Brand)))

ggplot(fulldata, aes(x = Relative_Year, 
                 y = Overall_Transparency, 
                 color = Brand, 
                 group = Brand)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(fulldata$Relative_Year),
                                  max(fulldata$Relative_Year), 1)) +
  labs(title = "Transparency Scores Over Time by Brand",
       x = "Years Relative to Sustainability Commitment",
       y = "Overall Transparency Score",
       color = "Brand") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
